original_units.oracle-hope-ops-settle.service:
# HOPE AUTOPILOT v1.0: isolated EVA, never production
[Unit]
Description=HOPE EVA guarded settle
After=docker.service network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target
[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=root
WorkingDirectory=/opt/ORACLE_EVA/hope_ops/current
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/ORACLE_EVA/hope_ops/current/hope_ops.py settle
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=true
TimeoutStartSec=2700
original_units.oracle-hope-ops-settle.timer:
# HOPE AUTOPILOT v1.0: isolated EVA, never production
[Unit]
Description=HOPE EVA guarded settle timer
[Timer]
Unit=oracle-hope-ops-settle.service
OnCalendar=hourly
RandomizedDelaySec=480
Persistent=true
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
